body: The Kensington Rodeo runs two full days — September 5 and 6 — at the rodeo grounds in Chickamauga. Check the Walker Rocks events page for tickets and details.

title: KZ106 Family Reunion
description: KZ106 Family Reunion event at Gordon Lee Mansion in Chickamauga, GA.
body: The KZ106 Family Reunion takes over the grounds of the Gordon Lee Mansion in Chickamauga for a Saturday evening event. Check the Walker Rocks events page for admission details.

title: Farmers on First Sunday Market
description: Weekly Sunday farmers market at First Street Square in downtown Cleveland, TN — open 11am to 2pm.
body: Farmers on First runs every Sunday from 11am to 2pm in downtown Cleveland's First Street Square pavilion. Twenty-plus vendors show up weekly with locally grown produce, handmade goods, and food. Free to attend, year-round — moves indoors to the Museum Center at 5ive Points during the coldest winter months.

title: Christmas on the Square
description: Holiday shopping, handmade gifts, and the community tree lighting at 6pm in downtown Cleveland, TN.
body: Downtown Cleveland kicks off the holiday season with local vendors selling handmade goods, art, and gifts. Santa shows up in the afternoon and the community tree lights at 6pm. Free and outdoors on the square.

title: Cleveland Christmas Parade
description: Cleveland's annual Christmas Parade with over 200 floats through downtown Cleveland, TN.
body: Over 200 floats work their way through downtown Cleveland starting at 6pm. One of the bigger small-city parades in the region — worth the drive up if you have kids or just want to stand on a sidewalk and watch something cheerful go by.

title: Cleveland Apple Festival
description: Two-day fall festival in Cleveland, TN celebrating the apple harvest with food, vendors, and live music.
body: Two days of fall festival in downtown Cleveland. Apple-themed food, local vendors, live music, and the kind of crowd that shows up in flannels and stays all afternoon. Full details at clevelandapplefestival.org.

title: MainStreet Cruise-In — August
description: Classic cars line the streets around Courthouse Square on the fourth Saturday of August.
body: Classic cars fill the streets around Courthouse Square from noon to 4pm. Local owners bring everything from restored muscle cars to polished pickup trucks. Walk the block, talk to the owners, grab lunch from a nearby spot.

title: MainStreet Cruise-In — October
description: The final MainStreet Cruise-In of the year in downtown Cleveland, TN.
body: Last one of the season. The fall light makes for good photos and the weather usually cooperates. Downtown Cleveland is an easy 30-minute drive from Chattanooga.

title: MainStreet Cruise-In — September
description: Classic car showcase in downtown Cleveland, TN on the fourth Saturday of September.
body: The fourth Saturday edition. Same format as the summer shows — cars parked along the square, owners happy to talk shop. The September crowd tends to be a little bigger before the season wraps.

title: Halloween Block Party
description: Cleveland's 35-year downtown Halloween tradition with live music, Treat Street, food, and a costume contest.
body: Downtown Cleveland's Halloween tradition runs 35 years deep. Treat Street hands out Mars chocolate by the fistful, there's live music on the square, food vendors, games, and a costume contest. Runs until 10pm.

title: Labor Day at Lookout Winery
description: Spend Labor Day at Lookout Winery in Guild, TN — open all day for the long weekend.
body: Lookout Winery stays open late on Labor Day — 11am to midnight. A good excuse to make the drive out to Guild and wind down the long weekend with local wine on the mountain.

title: National Red Wine Day at Lookout Winery
description: Celebrate National Red Wine Day at Lookout Winery in Guild, TN with a glass from their local selection.
body: Stop into Lookout Winery on National Red Wine Day and work through their local selection. The winery sits along Hwy 41 in Guild with views of Lookout Mountain. Open 11am to 8pm.

title: Apero on Main
description: Apero on Main is an evening community gathering on Main Street in downtown Jasper, TN.
body: Apero on Main is an evening out on Main Street in downtown Jasper — drinks, conversation, and community from 5 to 8:30pm. Think of it as a downtown happy hour with the whole neighborhood invited. Organized by Jasper Main Street.

title: Downtown Throwdown
description: Downtown Throwdown community event on Main Street in Jasper, TN.
body: The Downtown Throwdown brings the community out to Main Street in Jasper. Organized by Jasper Main Street. Check their site for details on what to expect.

title: Foothills Festival
description: Two-day Foothills Festival in downtown Jasper, TN — a community gathering on Main Street.
body: The Foothills Festival runs two days on Main Street in downtown Jasper. A community event organized by Jasper Main Street with local vendors, music, and food. Runs September 11 and 12. Check the Jasper Main Street website for full details.

title: 5 Points 50 MTB Race at Lula Lake
description: Mountain bike race at Lula Lake Land Trust on Lookout Mountain. Register via BikeReg.
body: The 5 Points 50 is a mountain bike race held on the trails of Lula Lake Land Trust on Lookout Mountain. Registration through BikeReg. Check the Lula Lake events page for full details and entry options.

title: Full Moon Yoga + Hike at Lula Lake
description: Evening hike and guided yoga on the bluff overlook at Lula Lake Land Trust under the full moon. No experience necessary.
body: Hike out to the bluff overlook at Lula Lake as the sun goes down, then drop into a guided yoga session with the full moon rising. A 500-hour certified instructor leads the yoga. No experience needed. Hike back down under the moonlight. Partial proceeds support Lula Lake's conservation mission.

title: Lula Lake Open Gate Days
description: Lula Lake opens to the public on the first and last weekends of each month. Reserve ahead — $16 per visit.
body: Lula Lake is only open to the public on the first and last weekends of each month — these are called Open Gate Days. The land trust protects over 8,000 acres on Lookout Mountain including two waterfalls, miles of trails, and old-growth forest. Gate closes at 1:00pm so arrive early. Reservations are required ($16) through Eventbrite — no walk-ups allowed. Book up to two months in advance.

title: Trail Blazer Race at Lula Lake
description: Trail running race at Lula Lake Land Trust on Lookout Mountain. Register via UltraSignUp.
body: The Trail Blazer Race is a trail running event on the grounds of Lula Lake Land Trust. Registration through UltraSignUp. Check the Lula Lake events page for distances, categories, and entry details.

title: Autumn Harvest Market — Cambridge Square
description: Autumn Harvest Market at Cambridge Square in Ooltewah with craft vendors and food.
body: Autumn Harvest Market brings together unique and traditional craft vendors plus food options at Cambridge Square. Free to attend.

title: Fall Market — Cambridge Square
description: Fall Market at Cambridge Square in Ooltewah with food trucks, craft vendors, kids activities, and free bounce house.
body: Fall Market at Cambridge Square features food trucks, a craft fair, kids and adult vendor markets, a free bounce house, and free activities. Pay-as-you-go craft stations also available. Free to attend.

title: Collegedale Academy Jazz Band Concert — Cambridge Square
description: Collegedale Academy Jazz Band performs live at Cambridge Square in Ooltewah, TN.
body: The Collegedale Academy Jazz Band performs live on the Cambridge Square lawn. Free and open to the public.

body: Live band performance on the lawn at Cambridge Square. Free outdoor show from 6:30–8:30pm. Check their Facebook page for artist details closer to the date.

description: Free live music every Saturday night at Cambridge Square in Ooltewah, late April through October.
body: Cambridge Square hosts free live music every Saturday night from late April through October. Local musicians play classic rock, country, jazz, and bluegrass on the outdoor stage. Weather permitting. Check their website or Facebook for the artist lineup each week.

title: Cruzin' the Depot
description: Classic car, truck, and bike show on the first Saturday of each month in historic downtown Ringgold, GA.
body: Cruzin' the Depot brings classic cars, trucks, and bikes to Nashville Street in historic downtown Ringgold on the first Saturday of each month. Free to attend and open to spectators. Runs June through November.

title: Front Porch Fridays
description: Live acoustic set by Paul Childers.
body: Front Porch Fridays is a free live acoustic music series at Benton Coal in downtown Ringgold, running every Friday evening through October. Local and regional musicians play from 7 to 9pm on Depot Street. Free to attend, no reservations needed.

title: The Ultimate Fall Fest
description: Family-friendly fall festival in Ringgold, GA with food trucks, vendors, live music, and children's activities.
body: The Ultimate Fall Fest at The Colonnade in Ringgold is a free family day with food trucks, local vendors, live music, and kids' activities. Runs 10am to 4pm. Free to attend.

title: Chili Cook Off at Rabbit Valley Farmers Market
description: Chili Cook Off at Rabbit Valley Farmers Market in Ringgold, GA — a special market day with competing chili makers.
body: The Chili Cook Off is one of Rabbit Valley's signature market days. Come taste and vote while shopping the regular Saturday lineup of local farmers and artisans. Free to attend.

title: Family Fall Festival at Rabbit Valley Farmers Market
description: Halloween Family Fall Festival at Rabbit Valley Farmers Market in Ringgold, GA.
body: The final market of the season goes all out for Halloween with a Family Fall Festival. Costumes welcome. Local vendors, fall produce, and seasonal goods on the last day of the 2026 market season. Free to attend.

title: Rabbit Valley Holiday Market
description: Rabbit Valley Holiday Market in Ringgold, GA — a special extended-hours market for the holiday season.
body: The Holiday Market runs outside the regular season with extended hours — 11am to 4pm. Local artisans and food vendors set up for holiday shopping in downtown Ringgold. Free to attend.

title: Rabbit Valley Farmers Market
description: Weekly Saturday farmers market in downtown Ringgold, GA — open May through October, 9am to 1pm.
body: Rabbit Valley Farmers Market runs every Saturday morning from May through October in historic downtown Ringgold. Local farmers, food producers, and artisans from across North Georgia bring produce, meats, baked goods, and handcrafted items. Free to attend, 9am to 1pm. Special themed markets throughout the season.

title: National Cornbread Festival
description: Annual festival in downtown South Pittsburg, TN every last weekend of April — food, music, and cornbread competitions.
body: The National Cornbread Festival takes over downtown South Pittsburg every last weekend of April. It's a two-day outdoor festival 30 miles west of Chattanooga with live music, a cornbread cook-off, family activities, a 5K, and a cycling event. Free parking with shuttle service. Rain or shine.

title: Ketner's Mill Country Arts Fair
description: Annual two-day country arts fair at the historic Ketner's Mill in Whitwell, TN — 150+ artisans, live bluegrass, food vendors, and a working grist mill.
body: Ketner's Mill has been running this fair since 1977. Over 150 artisans set up across the historic mill grounds in Whitwell — pottery, sculpture, jewelry, woodworking, and more. Live bluegrass and country music all weekend, 20+ food vendors, sorghum molasses demonstrations, wagon rides, canoe rides, and a petting zoo. Runs two days, October 3 and 4. $8 admission, kids 8 and under free.
